title: Volume comparison and rigidity for positive holomorphic sectional curvature
summary: We prove that the volume of a compact connected Kähler manifold with holomorphic sectional curvature at least 2 is bounded above by the volume of the Fubini-Study metric of constant holomorphic sectional curvature 2 on the complex projective space of the same dimension. Moreover equality holds if and only if the manifold is biholomorphically isometric to complex projective space. This answers a question posed by Xiong and Yang.
